selection.rule: Pools of the exact hooks that reviewed launchpad platforms publish as their own, and of the hooks that named projects deploy, measured at most 24 hours before the live snapshot; for Doppler, Clanker, Zora and Flaunch the 50 pools with the highest 24h volume among those measured at most 7 days before it. Chosen once from the live Hook Radar's published snapshot; the pool's project is a label for the reader, ownership is decided from the exact hook.
